Game Overview

Geometrical Dash is a skill game built around dash through vibrant levels as a daring square, leaping over spikes and avoiding pitfalls with a single-tap jump command. Perfect your timing to conquer each level's obstacles. Keep track of your attempts and beat your personal best in this thrilling test of reflexes and precision.
